overview_description.description:
NymCard is a full-stack, API-first embedded finance platform that provides payment infrastructure for banks, fintechs, enterprises, and telecom providers. The platform enables seamless card issuance, transaction processing, digital lending, and real-time money movement through its proprietary nCore system. Operating across multiple countries, NymCard owns its processing and switching technology, offering greater control and flexibility without reliance on third-party providers.

The company is licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE, ensuring compliance with financial regulations while helping institutions scale their financial services. By integrating with global and regional payment networks, NymCard supports businesses in launching and managing payment products efficiently.

product.name: NymCard Platform
product.description: An API-first embedded finance platform for launching and operating branded card, payment, credit, and lending products across MENA and Pakistan.

product.name: Card Issuing
product.description: A card issuing and processing service for launching Visa, Mastercard, and supported regional-scheme cards in virtual, physical, or tokenized formats.

product.name: Money Movement
product.description: A payment infrastructure service for domestic and cross-border transfers through cards, accounts, wallets, and regional payment networks.

product.name: Embedded Lending
product.description: A configurable lending infrastructure service for credit decisioning, scoring, loan configuration, repayments, and embedded credit experiences.

product.name: Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL)
product.description: An end-to-end BNPL infrastructure service for offering installment or deferred-payment options at online and in-store checkout.

product.name: Nym4Business
product.description: A modular business-finance platform that enables banks and financial providers to offer branded SME cards, credit, payments, and spend-management capabilities.
